claims.body: The Sharks are around the middle of the league for shots from defensemen, and the Bruins are one of the worst. It’s the widest gap between these two, though not a huge one.

BOS.head: The Bruins should have the upper hand
BOS.body: Boston has been out-chancing opponents lately and has home-ice advantage. The Sharks can make it interesting if they keep the shots coming.

SJS.head: Not an easy night for the Sharks
SJS.body: Boston has been out-chancing opponents lately and has home-ice advantage. The Sharks’ best way through is piling up shots.

items.text: The Sharks are newly without Igor Chernyshov and Alexander Wennberg.
The Bruins are newly without Jonathan Aspirot, and have been without Connor Clifton since Oct 10.
JJ Peterka has six goals in eight games against San Jose since 2023-24, most of them with Buffalo.
Casey Mittelstadt is one goal from 100.
